summary: Iteration 3 (frontend notifications for Pedilo admin panel) — COMPLETE PASS. Verified all 9 acceptance criteria via Playwright with an AudioContext monkey-patch that counts oscillator creations to detect chime firing without relying on audible output.
test_scope: Frontend only (per review_request). Backend unchanged from iteration 2, not re-tested.

tests_executed.name: Click toggle ON: text='Sonido ON', localStorage['pedilo_sound_enabled']='1', AudioContext constructed (ctxCount=1), preview chime plays (2 oscillators), Notification permission requested
Preference persists across full page reload (localStorage='1', text='Sonido ON')
No chime fires on first mount even when pending orders already exist (false-positive prevention via firstLoadRef)
tests_executed.result: PASS — oscCount=0 after initial stats call despite badge=2

tests_executed.name: document.title updates to '(N) Pedilo · Admin' when pending>0
New order via POST /api/public/orders triggers: chime (oscillator created), success toast '🔔 ¡Nuevo pedido!', badge increment 2→3, title update (2)→(3) Pedilo · Admin within ~20s poll window
Click toggle again: text='Activar sonido', localStorage='0'
With sound OFF: new order causes NO chime and NO toast, but badge still silently increments (3→4) and title still updates
Regression: admin tabs (config, categories, products, combos, orders) remain clickable
document.title resets to 'Pedilo · Admin' when pending=0 (after deleting all pending orders)

code_review_comments: Clean, focused implementation. AdminDashboard.jsx (~195 lines) and notify.js (~89 lines) are well-sized.
Good use of refs (prevPendingRef, firstLoadRef) to prevent false-positive chime on initial mount.
AudioContext is lazily created & resumed correctly — respects browsers' user-gesture autoplay policy (primeAudio on first click).
Desktop notifications correctly skipped when document.visibilityState === 'visible' (good UX — toast alone is enough when tab is focused).

Minor suggestion (not a bug): the `showDesktopNotification` call uses tag 'pedilo-new-order' with renotify — if many orders come in while tab is hidden, only the latest is shown; this is acceptable but the delta count is still accurate.
Minor suggestion: consider capping polling frequency or adding a back-off if /admin/orders/stats repeatedly fails to avoid log-spam on network issues (currently catches silently, which is fine).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test orders via POST /api/public/orders during polling tests. ALL test orders (including 2 leftover from earlier runs) were cleaned up via DELETE /api/admin/orders/{id} at end of test; pending count verified back to 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 notifications are fully verified. Key technique: use page.add_init_script BEFORE navigation to wrap window.AudioContext and count createOscillator calls — this detects chime reliably without audio playback. playNewOrderChime creates 2 oscillators per call (A5 + D6). Remember to call page.goto AFTER add_init_script since the automation tool auto-navigates first.
